name: Text to Image to Video (Dynamic)
description: Dynamically expand multiple shots from a text idea, generate key images first, then generate a video for each shot and compose automatically.

keywords: generate video from a text prompt

planning.planning_notes: Decide the number of shots dynamically from the user description and duration; each plan item corresponds to one key image and one video clip.
planning.prompt_guide: Keep the subject, scene and visual style continuous across shots; each plan item describes only one shot.
conduct_rules: Dynamically decide the number of nodes and their dependencies from the user goal
Use only the capabilities declared in allowed_recipe_ids
Generate and confirm the dynamic plan before creating canvas nodes

rating_bands.description: Fully meets the user goal and the workflow can be executed
Core flow is complete; a few non-critical adjustments are allowed
Missing key stages or incomplete dependencies

domain_constraints: The workflow must match the user goal and keep the input assets consistent
